title: The Wall Street Journal Is Lying About UFOs
tags: The Wall Street Journal Is Lying About UFOs
description:
The Wall Street Journal, written by journalists Joel Schectman and Aruna Viswanatha, just published an article admitting the Pentagon has used deception in the past to cover up UFO activity. But instead of following that thread, they pivot to a new claim, suggesting that these sightings and reports are all part of a multi-decade long military hazing ritual. Yes, seriously.

In this episode, I break down why that explanation completely falls apart and how it mirrors the same kind of Cold War-era perception management we have seen before. Intelligence agencies have a long history of planting false stories to hide real encounters. This is not a theory. It is documented fact.

From Project Mockingbird to strategic psychological operations, the goal has always been the same. Control the narrative, ridicule the witnesses, and flood the space with disinformation to keep the public confused. There is a clear pattern here and it stretches across decades.

That is why we need to demand real UAP transparency from Congress. No more distractions. No more excuses. The public deserves the truth about what is happening in our skies.
